versions.content: Function signature containing the keyword enum in C The respective ImplementationDataType or ImplementationDataTypeEle- ment has to include the string “enum” in the associated SwDataDefProps . addi- tionalNativeTypeQualifier and use an associated CompuMethod with category TEXTTABLE . Hints: This information can be used by a code generator to create the correct signa- ture. In case this method is applied to generate C-style enums it should be avoided to use the same CompuMethod as input to a generator (for example the RTE genera- tor) that produces preprocessor literals instead. Otherwise, the enum-literals and the preprocessor-literals might get in conflict.
